sentences.text: Watch for signs of dragging: your bearings or GPS position keep changing, the rode jerks or vibrates, or the boat lies at a different angle to the wind than nearby boats.
Let out more scope, or pick up and re-anchor.
Always anchor from the bow, never the stern.
A boat anchored by the stern presents its low transom to the waves and can be swamped in minutes.
If your anchor fouls under a rock or ledge, a trip line tied to the anchor’s crown lets you pull it out backward.
And keep an anchor watch whenever the weather is changing.
